issues.title: Ingest Little River County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $15,320,272 across 35 funds. The largest: General Fund ($4,440,354), County Road Fund ($2,315,507), Solid Waste ($1,841,211). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
